Reviewed their history and the margin on this book. Short take and recommended structure to present to execs: 

- Discount: offer an 18% first-year concession off list for the renewal. 
  Rationale: 20% is near-stretch; 18% is within prior precedent (Lumenex/Nexoria comparables) and keeps NPV acceptable.
- SLA credit: approve a one-time credit equal to one month of committed spend (~$48,000). We should tie the credit to documented outage impact; legal to add the attachment.
- Term reset: approve resetting the 12-month anniversary conditional on them signing a new 12-month committed term and paying at least 50% upfront.

Estimated revenue impact first year: ~$360k reduction vs list; net-retention improvement vs churn scenario. We should require the following: immediate signature, limited to this renewal (no precedent), and a short addendum to be executed via DocuSign.

Attachments: margin_run_ORBS-042.xlsx (internal) — forwarding summary.

If you want to escalate, I recommend Marissa sign off with legal to prep a short SLA amendment and an addendum with a one-paragraph non-precedent clause.

-Karthik
